lines.en: One hop, two hops, stop.
Mud wraps around my feet.
I hop across a patch of duckweed.
The lily pad swayed; that was me.
The water's edge is slick; I go slowly.
My belly nearly touches the ground.
I don't jump high, but I jump far.
Reeds block the way; I slip beneath.
Every hop comes with a croak.
Dew wets my back.

lines.zh: 沼泽的路我闭着眼都会走。
lines.en: I could walk the swamp blind.
I stepped on my own shadow.
Front feet down, back feet follow.

lines.zh: 从这片叶子跳到那片叶子。
lines.en: From this leaf to that one.

lines.zh: 我跳到石头上，滑了一下。
lines.en: I hop onto a stone and slip a little.

lines.zh: 水里映出两个我，一起跳。
lines.en: Two of me show in the water, hopping together.
Croak, croak, rain is coming.
I puff my cheeks and wait for bugs.
So many mosquitoes on the water.
I stay still as a stone.
The sun has made the lily pad hot.

lines.zh: 我咽了一下，什么也没有。
lines.en: I swallow; there was nothing.
Something is moving in the mud.
My skin is always wet.
The mangrove roots look like fingers.

lines.zh: 我在等一只飞得慢的蝇。
lines.en: I wait for a slow-flying fly.
Ripples spread in rings.
I let out a very loud burp.
This water lily is my seat.
It's dark; the bugs should come out.
The water is deep where you stand.
You stepped on my lily pad.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛为什么这么大。
lines.en: Why are your eyes so big.
Can you catch bugs.

lines.zh: 我抬头只能看见你的下巴。
lines.en: Looking up, I only see your chin.

lines.zh: 你身上没有沼泽的味道。
lines.en: You don't smell of the swamp.
Hold on, there's a bug on your shoulder.
Are you coming in? The water is cold.
I blinked, and so did you.
You're blocking my sun.
Croak! My back leg.
You stepped on me, so heavy.
My skin is torn, it hurts.
I'm slippery and sore.

lines.zh: 别打我，我只是一只青蛙。
lines.en: Don't hit me, I'm only a frog.
That made my cheeks puff out.
I can't hop anymore.
The water is right there; I want to go back.
You soaked my nest.
I'll remember that sound.
That little slime, give it to me.
Something is hopping; I saw it.
Is that the smell of bugs.

lines.zh: 你手里动的那个，放下来。
lines.en: That wriggling thing in your hand, put it down.

lines.zh: 我的舌头已经准备好了。
lines.en: My tongue is already ready.
Don't wave it, I can't aim.
I love sticky things best.
Step back, let me catch it myself.
Can I swallow that in one go.
Croak! That one is mine.
You flattened my mud puddle.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，我滑出去好远。
lines.en: One bump and I slide far.
Your boot is bigger than I am.
Don't push, I was about to jump.
I'm slippery; you can't hold me.
Water splashed all over my face.

lines.zh: 你把我从叶子上挤下去了。
lines.en: You shoved me off the leaf.
Don't press, my belly is soft.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，都滑开了。
lines.en: We bumped and both slid away.
Make room, I'm going back to the water.
That frog is calling me.
Croak, croak, did you hear that.
We will lay eggs in the water.
Her voice is brighter than mine.
The tadpoles grow back legs first.
I swam three circles around the lily pad.
Don't disturb us, this is serious business.
She hops, I hop after her.
This shallow water is just right.

lines.zh: 春天水里会全是小蝌蚪。
lines.en: In spring the water will be full of tadpoles.
I'll take this lump of mud home.
A fallen leaf, perfect to sit on.
I can't carry anything heavy.
Whose petal is this? So soft.
I roll it up with my tongue.

lines.zh: 这颗小石子滑进嘴里了。
lines.en: This pebble slipped into my mouth.
I'll take it back to line my nest.

lines.zh: 亮亮的东西我不太会捡。
lines.en: I'm not good at picking up shiny things.
A short reed will do.
I balance it on my head.
A bug landed on the water.
Small, sticky, and perfect.
My eyes can see it move.
It's less than a tongue-length away.

lines.zh: 那只小史莱姆跳过来了。
lines.en: That little slime hopped over.
I crouch and tuck my back legs.
It's small; I have plenty of patience.
It hasn't noticed me.
A mosquito flew over my head.
I want the thing that moves.
Still, still, a little closer.
My tongue is coiled in my mouth.
It stopped; that is good.
I've worked out the distance.
One second, two, now.
It crawled to the leaf's edge.
I've even stopped breathing.
The water's moving; wait.
My throat is swelling.
It flew up; I can't follow.
My tongue shoots out and sticks.
Got it, rolling it back in.
Swallowed clean in one go.
So sticky and so good.
Your boot is too hard to bite.
I flicked out and landed back on the leaf.
My tongue tip hit it, smack.
Little thing, you can't get away.

lines.zh: 我吞下去时鼓了一下眼。
lines.en: My eyes bulged as I swallowed.
Don't take it, this one's mine.
I crawl out of the water onto the bank.
My tadpole days are over.
My first croak is very hoarse.

lines.zh: 我从红树林的泥浆里钻出来。
lines.en: I climb out of the mangrove mud.
My tail is gone.
Mud slides off my back.
This lily pad can be my bed.
The mangrove water is brown.
I've just grown four legs.
So quiet, only the insects are singing.
The fire is drying out my skin.
Landed on a stone; my belly hurts.
I can't breathe in the water.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，我被掀进泥里。
lines.en: A blast threw me into the mud.
An arrow grazed my back, so cold.
The potion smell ties my tongue.
No bugs; I'm frantic with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷打在沼泽上，亮得刺眼。
lines.en: Lightning struck the swamp, blindingly bright.

lines.zh: 我掉下去了，下面没有水。
lines.en: I'm falling, and there's no water below.
